messages.text: Kane and Bayern’s Ballon d’Or push: ‘It can only be Harry’

metadata.summary: Harry Kane is the favourite to win the Ballon d’Or. Having spent the past week talking to some of the key figures at Bayern Munich – as well as Kane himself – it is apparent that clinching this award is as important to the German club as it is the England captain.
metadata.content: Harry Kane’s Ballon d'Or push: Why Bayern Munich believe winning the award could be big for the player and the club | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to content Analysis Harry Kane’s Ballon d'Or push: Why Bayern Munich believe winning the award could be big for the player and the club With Harry Kane in the frame to win the Ballon d'Or this year, Adam Bate visits Germany to find out more about why claiming the award matters to Bayern Munich too. "Being a platform for a Ballon d'Or winner is something which counts more than statistics." Adam Bate Football Features Writer @ghostgoal Monday 24 August 2026 08:40, UK Image: Harry Kane lifted the Franz Beckenbauer Supercup for Bayern Munich in Dortmund Harry Kane is the favourite to win the Ballon d’Or. Having spent the past week talking to some of the key figures at Bayern Munich – as well as Kane himself – it is apparent that clinching this award is as important to the German club as it is the England captain. Speaking to Christoph Freund, Bayern's sporting director, just before their win over Borussia Dortmund in the Franz Beckenbauer Supercup, he was emphatic on the subject. "I think he deserves to win the Ballon d'Or. He played an outstanding season." Putting that question to Rouven Kasper, a member of Bayern's executive board, he went further. "It can only be Harry Kane. We can just give it to Harry." Bayern are pushing for this Ballon d'Or and - with a new deal on the table - want to be seen to be pushing for it. Please use
